items.title: Spain high-speed train collision kills 30
AI’s brain & muscle
items.summary: ARTIFICIAL intelligence is usually presented as weightless, almost entirely digital. We ask it to write, calculate, translate or create an image, and the response appears instantly. Yet every answer depends on a substantial physical system. This comprises data centres, specialised processors, cooling equipment etc. In reality AI has both ‘brain’ and ‘muscle’
